title: A2A / SSH / Hosted Compliance Gap Map v1

a2a.status: non_compliant — A2A must be blocked from accepting tasks until trust tiers and attestation are enforced
a2a.current_maturity: partial — models defined, server has real JSON-RPC transport, task state machine implemented

gaps.current: tasks/send handler accepts tasks and transitions to SUBMITTED with zero governance checks. Only guard is rate-limiting budgets.
gaps.required: Gate A2A task submission through governance engine. Validate trust tier before accepting tasks. Block tasks/send until governance exists.

gaps.current: A2AAgentCard, A2ATaskCard, A2ATaskLifecycleEvent, A2ADelegationReceipt have NO HMAC, signature, or cryptographic attestation fields.
gaps.required: Add HMAC-signed attestation fields. Verify attestation before any state transition.

gaps.current: build_delegation_receipt() exists in _lifecycle.py but is never called by the server. Tasks are created without producing delegation receipts.
gaps.required: Produce delegation receipts for every A2A task submission.

gaps.current: A2ALocalIdentity.federation_trust_boundary defined but not enforced. No multi-tier trust model with per-tier gating.
gaps.required: Enforce multi-tier trust model: none → local_only → workspace_federation → remote_federation. Gate task submission on trust boundary.

compliant_areas.detail: federation_trust_boundary and A2ASecurityScheme exist but are not enforced.
input_hash and output_hash exist as SHA256 fields but no cryptographic attestation (HMAC/signature).
_budgets rate limiter exists but no per-task timeout or scope enforcement.

ssh.finding: Zero SSH code exists in the codebase. No remote shell execution path. No SSH key management. No asyncssh or paramiko imports. Audit document ssh_remote_surface_audit_v1.v1.json classifies SSH as 'maturity: missing — zero implementation.' Forward-looking SSH use cases are aspirational only.
required_if_ssh_added: Read-only diagnostics doctrine must be implemented before any remote execution
SSH must route through RuntimeSupervisor wrapping
Key/secret handling via credential store, never in plaintext
Receipt and session recording for every SSH session
No-shell constraints enforced — reject interactive shell sessions

hosted_team.status: missing — placeholders only. Tenant and fleet admin scripts exist but operate without governance. Hosted mode not yet operational.

gaps.current: Enterprise tenant admin script registers tenants and grants permissions with zero governance checks.
gaps.required: Gate tenant operations through governance engine. Multi-tenant isolation must be enforced at data layer (PostgreSQL RLS) and governance layer.

gaps.current: Fleet admin script starts/stops fleet instances without governance.
gaps.required: Gate fleet operations through governance engine.

blocked_until: Tenant isolation via PostgreSQL RLS enforced
Fail-closed Postgres semantics in enterprise mode
Governance engine gated tenant and fleet operations
